## Description

Replace the licence verify and reject endpoint, OperationsPolicies.LicenceReview and the Operations:LicenceReviewers id list with an organisation-approval capability. Minimal operations endpoints (reason required, audited, applicant emailed a plain reason for changes, rejection or suspension) read only the control-plane request and its documents, through a narrow reviewed read path inside row-level security. MDV-P5-044 later puts a queue UI on the same capability.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a user without the organisation-approval capability, when they call the endpoints, then 403 (server-side test).
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a Submitted request, when an authorised operator approves, asks for changes, rejects or suspends with a reason, then the state changes, the audit names the operator, and the applicant is emailed the reason.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given any of these endpoints, when called, then no patient data is returned and none is logged.
- [ ] **AC4.** Operations:LicenceReviewers and the doctor licence endpoints are removed, and the capability is mutation-checked.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
